guide.title: How to Use "What to Eat Today?"
guide.intro: Find a great restaurant nearby in just 3 steps.
guide.step1text: Tap the "Find restaurants near me" button at the top to get your GPS location. Even without GPS access, we show popular restaurants near Tokyo Station by default.
guide.step2text: Select from walking, cycling, or driving, then set your travel time limit (5, 10, 15 minutes, etc.). Only restaurants reachable within your chosen time will be shown.
guide.step3text: Choose from 17+ cuisine types including Japanese, Ramen, Italian, Café, and more. You can select multiple cuisines at once.
guide.step4text: Browse restaurants by Google Maps star ratings and review counts. Tap a card to see address, hours, phone number, and other details.
guide.rouletteText: When you just can't choose, tap the "Can't decide?" button in the bottom right. The roulette will randomly pick a restaurant for you.
guide.langText: Available in 5 languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean. Switch languages using the button in the top right.
guide.feature1: The only app that lets you search by transport mode and travel time
guide.feature2: Can't decide? The roulette picks for you instantly
guide.feature3: Available in 5 languages for international visitors to Japan

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Having trouble? Check here for answers.
faq.a1: Please enable location services in your browser settings. On iPhone, go to Settings > Privacy > Location Services. On Android, go to Settings > Location. Even without GPS, we display popular restaurants near Tokyo Station by default.
faq.a2: Restaurant data comes from Google Maps Platform. Business hours and holidays are based on information registered on Google Maps, but may not reflect temporary closures. We recommend confirming directly with the restaurant.
faq.a3: We support 17+ cuisine types including Japanese, Izakaya, Ramen, Café, Italian, Yakiniku, Chinese, Bar, Sushi, Curry, Western, Korean, French, Thai, Mexican, Okonomiyaki, and Creative cuisine.
faq.q4: How does the 'Open now' filter work?
faq.a4: We check Google Maps Platform business hours against the current time. Restaurants without registered hours will show as 'Unknown'.
faq.a5: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean — 5 languages total. Perfect for international visitors to Japan.
faq.a6: It randomly selects one restaurant from the current filtered results (transport, time, cuisine, and open-now filters all apply).
faq.a7: Yes, all features are completely free to use.
faq.q8: Do I need to install an app?
faq.a8: No, it works directly in your web browser. No installation needed — accessible from both smartphones and computers.

about.title: About "What to Eat Today?"
about.conceptText: "What to Eat Today?" is a restaurant search service for anyone who struggles to decide where to eat. "What should I have for lunch?" "Where should we go for drinks tonight?" We help you solve these everyday dilemmas in seconds.
about.feature1: Filter by distance and travel time from your current location
about.feature2: Choose trusted restaurants by Google Maps star ratings
about.feature3: Search with 17+ cuisine filters to match your preferences
about.feature4: Show only currently open restaurants with one tap
about.feature5: Roulette feature for the truly indecisive
about.feature6: Available in 5 languages: Japanese, English, Chinese, Korean
about.visitorText: We support 5 languages to help travelers visiting Japan find delicious restaurants with ease.
